name: Daily County-Level Stratified Admission Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid inpatient hospitalization counts (n_hosp) and beneficiary counts (n_bene) by cohort, stratified by age group, sex, race, dual status, managed care, and eligibility group. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.
